visual_positioning: Executive dark-mode business deck for board, strategy, investor, and global stakeholder presentations
title_hierarchy_rules: Use one clear headline per slide.
Use subtitles only for context or a business implication.
Keep body copy short and scannable.
Use amber only for decisive metrics or priority signals.
module_layout_patterns: headline insight plus 3 executive proof points
chart_rules: Prefer bar, line, matrix, waterfall, and milestone charts.
Use cyan for structure and amber for the main takeaway.
icon_rules: Keep icons secondary to the message.
prompt_block: Language: English. Use a deep navy dark-mode executive style with slate panels, cyan structure, amber emphasis, and concise business copy. Keep every page readable, restrained, analytical, and appropriate for board-level or global stakeholder presentations.
